name: Best Video Games of All Time - Metacritic
description: Dataset derived from the Kaggle dataset 'Best Video Games of All Time - Metacritic'. It contains around 20,500 videogames with information about their release date, developer, platform, genres, number of players, ESRB rating, metascore, user score.

variableMeasured.name: release_date
variableMeasured.description: Date on which the videogame was released

variableMeasured.name: platform
variableMeasured.description: Platform on which the videogame was released

variableMeasured.name: number_of_players
variableMeasured.description: Number of players supported by the videogame

variableMeasured.name: metascore
variableMeasured.description: Metascore of the videogame as given by Metacritic

variableMeasured.name: user_score
variableMeasured.description: User score of the videogame as given by Metacritic
